changelog: Full controller support. Every screen works on a gamepad: a highlight moves between buttons with the D-pad, a cursor walks the battlefield, LB and RB step through your hand, RT plays a card, LT opens it (Keep or Play), Y ends the turn and Menu opens Settings. Button prompts show Xbox or PlayStation symbols to match your controller, and touching the mouse hands control straight back. Headline type now covers Nordic, Central European, Baltic, Turkish, Vietnamese, Greek and Cyrillic letters. A card selection left stale by a re-dealt hand is dropped rather than misread. Mac: universal (Apple Silicon and Intel), Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled. Minimum macOS 11. 1,312 tests. Controller support on the Mac has not been tested against a real pad yet -- it is verified on Windows and on Steam Deck -- so if you have one, that is the thing worth trying.
